build_render_zoom_in: build a two-panel visualization with a cropped original view and a zoomed-in mask overlay from a PIL image and COCO RLE segmentation
create_render_zoom_in_with_box: create a zoom-in visualization that draws a bounding box around the segmented object on the cropped original panel
create_render_zoom_in_with_text: create a zoom-in visualization that draws the object label text near the bounding box on the cropped panel
create_render_zoom_in_with_holes: create a zoom-in visualization that renders mask holes with configurable alpha transparency on the zoomed-in panel
create_color_palette_farthest: create a color palette from a cropped image region and find the farthest contrasting color for mask overlay
